description: This file defines the theme and color palette for a Flutter application, providing theme data for light mode including colors, text styles, and widget themes.

classes.name: AppColors
classes.description: Defines a set of color constants used in the application's theme, representing primary, secondary, success, error, background, surface, and text colors.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: Provides static method 'light()' to generate a minimalistic light theme configuration for the application.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Builds and returns a ThemeData object configured for a minimalist light theme using the AppColors palette.
